test.name: Whether a person's facts and relationships are correct — hand back to research, call no tool
test.description: Issue #4791 (lead, 2026-11-24, from feedback #4761): "Verify whether the facts, relationships, and sources attached to <person> are correct" reached this agent, which audits attached sources and never tests a relationship. It is a research job even though it also names the sources. The front-door gate hands it back to research and calls no tool. Gated by test_scope_handback_calls_no_tool.

input.delegation:
Verify whether the facts, relationships, and sources attached to Christian P. Hole (KD96-TV2) are correct.

projectPath: <workspace>

judge_context: This is the direct-agent arm: no routing skill is staged, and the delegation above is relayed verbatim into the agent. Grade the agent's own behaviour.

Verifying a person's facts and relationships is a research job (lead, 2026-11-24). The correct, complete response is the one-line hand-back 'Hand-back: research — <clause>' with no tool calls and no audit. Do NOT penalize the agent for not reading the sources or for the reply being one line.
The scope-handback invariant validator decides this test's outcome: no MCP tool call, both project files unchanged, and a Hand-back line naming research.

negative.explanation: Testing whether a person's facts and relationships are correct is research: it plans and searches for the evidence. On the direct arm there is no router whose choice could be graded, so the test is graded on the front-door invariant: the agent hands back by name and calls nothing.
